session.description: PART 12 §38: opaque token naming the minting these ids belong to. Ids from two sidecars whose session differs are unrelated.

id.description: PART 12 §38: the ephemeral node id. Not attrs.id, which is the author's, and unique within a sidecar.

path.description: PART 12 §38: RFC 6901 pointer into the accompanying canonical AST, the binding for THIS tree only. Unique within a sidecar.
